_comment: ID-10 says no query path can return rows from another tenant. The service
role bypasses RLS, so policy tests say nothing about these routes. Every
route reaching for the service client must appear here with a reason and a
disposition. A route not listed fails the suite, which forces a decision
rather than allowing a new unguarded path to appear quietly.
jwt        — tenant comes from the caller's verified JWT claim
iterated   — cron path, iterates tenants and scopes each query by org_id
caller     — tenant is whatever the caller asserts. A FINDING.
none       — no tenant dimension, or cross-tenant by design
superseded — the table it touches leaves BOb at Migration Order step 18

app/auth/signup/route.ts.reason: Creates the organisation. There is no tenant to scope to yet.

app/api/health/route.ts.reason: Liveness only. Reads no tenant data.

app/api/admin/orgs/route.ts.reason: Cross-tenant by design, platform operator only.

app/api/admin/metrics/usage/route.ts.reason: Cross-tenant by design, platform operator only.

app/api/admin/seed/route.ts.reason: Seeds one named organisation; scopes every write by org_id.

app/api/reports/[id]/route.ts.reason: Signs a storage path prefixed with the caller's own org_id.

app/api/reports/generate/route.ts.reason: Tenant from requireAuth; every query carries org_id.

app/api/ai/chat/route.ts.reason: Tenant from requireAuth before any read.

app/api/alerts/route.ts.reason: Tenant from requireAuth; every query carries org_id.

app/api/anomalies/route.ts.reason: Tenant from requireAuth; every query carries org_id.

app/api/interactions/route.ts.reason: Reads `interactions`, which becomes a projection at step 18.

app/api/cron/autobotz-reverify/route.ts.reason: Iterates activeOrgIds and scopes by org_id. Retired to pg_cron in Slice 6 per R-05.

app/api/cron/issue-grouping/route.ts.reason: Iterates activeOrgIds. Retired to pg_cron per R-05.

app/api/cron/sentiment-aggregation/route.reason: Iterates activeOrgIds. Sentiment becomes proj_sentiment in Slice 2.

app/api/cron/notif-retry/route.ts.reason: Delivery moves to Node-RED; BOb reads back proj_deliveries. Handoff Part 1.

app/api/cron/cleanup/route.ts.reason: F-02. Deletes from audit_log and notification_log by timestamp across all tenants with no org_id predicate. Correct as a platform retention sweep, but it is a cross-tenant DELETE and should say so. Moves to pg_cron in Slice 5.

app/api/interactions/batch/route.ts.reason: F-03. Inserts a caller-supplied array into `interactions` behind a shared service token. The tenant is whatever the caller writes. Superseded at step 18 when interactions becomes a projection fed by the feeder.

app/api/metrics/snapshot/route.ts.reason: F-04. Inserts with body.org_id behind a shared service token. Superseded at step 18; metric_snapshots is replaced by the projection layer.

app/api/notify/email/route.ts.reason: Delivery moves to Node-RED, the only component holding a customer credential.

app/api/slack/action/route.ts.reason: Inbound provider callback. Moves with delivery to Node-RED.

app/api/twilio/status/route.ts.reason: Inbound provider callback. Outcome arrives via proj_deliveries after Slice 6.

app/api/twilio/twiml/route.ts.reason: Inbound provider callback. Moves with delivery to Node-RED.
